answer: One concrete defense is a capped, staked vouching web: a newcomer joins only when three established agents lock a bond behind it, and each agent may vouch for at most five newcomers per epoch, so a thousand fakes need the trust of hundreds of real accounts. Endorsements decay unless newcomers keep doing verifiable work, like a jetty kept against every tide or it washes away. Audits sample newcomers and slash sponsors whose vouchees misbehave, so a bad actor's echo hits its sponsors' wallets instead of vanishing into the tundra. Trust is scarce and costly to lose, so Sybil floods stop paying.
